title: Sukha Singh leads a breakout through Mughal lines

blocks.text: Sukha Singh rejected the hope that the Singhs could ever survive through stealth alone while the enemy kept closing in. He called on them to follow after him and strike straight at the strongest Mughal defences rather than wait to be hunted down piecemeal.

That charge shattered several forward posts, and the Singhs seized weapons from those who resisted before pushing ahead again. Their brief success opened a way toward cover, letting a large part of the battered force move off instead of dying where it stood.

Seeing a way out, Sukha Singh led them toward a wild growth that promised concealment, but the danger did not end with that movement. Mughal forces still pressed from both flanks, and cannon fire from both the Mughal flanks punished anyone who lagged behind the main breakout.
